components.name: cell_counts
components.note: fraction of in-focus wells with |n_cells - planted| <= max(abs, rel) tolerance; full credit >= 0.90

components.name: qc_flags
components.note: Matthews correlation of qc_pass = 0 with the wells rendered out of focus; full credit >= 0.90

components.name: marker_potency
components.note: per compound: 'inactive' must match; active: |log10(est/planted)| <= full tolerance gives 1, >= zero tolerance gives 0; component = ramp(mean credit, 0.8 -> 1.0)

components.name: count_potency
components.note: per compound: 'inactive' must match; active: |log10(est/planted)| <= full tolerance gives 1, >= zero tolerance gives 0; component = ramp(mean credit, 0.8 -> 1.0)
